integrity: Established exact finite-N and single-particle formulas are explicitly credited. New claims are restricted to the jointly scaled marked point process, sharp strong-approximation rate, and correlated logarithmic survivor law; the packaged finite checker does not prove the asymptotic theorem.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional independent Brownian first passages from one fixed source with independent exponential mortality, initial synchronized N, fixed critical parameter c. No interacting, heterogeneous-death, recruiting or higher-dimensional extension; no empirical validation or independent originality certification.
title: Critical Poisson–Gaussian arrivals and logarithmic survivor fluctuations in mortal Brownian search
